question: Among the dated events recorded in the timeline, list the events in which Veltroni was elected to, or resigned from, the leadership of a political party, in time order.
criterion: dated events in which Veltroni is recorded as elected to, or resigning from, the leadership of a political party (National Secretary of the Democrats of the Left, leader of the Democratic Party); candidacies and statements about leading a campaign are excluded
why_needs_multiple: Câu liệt kê cần nhiều lần thay đổi vị trí lãnh đạo đảng, mỗi lần là một mốc riêng.

question: Among the dated events recorded in the timeline, which two events are the last two of the dated events about his office as Mayor of Rome (taking office, re-election and resignation from it)?
criterion: dated events of his office as Mayor of Rome: taking office, re-election, resignation from the office; the 2001 party-leadership resignation (e23) and the 2005 meeting with Obama (e28) are excluded
why_needs_multiple: Đáp án là hai mốc cuối của chuỗi sự kiện chức Thị trưởng, nên phải có cả mốc trước cuối và mốc cuối.

question: By calendar year, how many years passed from his election as a Rome city councillor to his election to the Italian Chamber of Deputies?
criterion: two named elections to public office: Rome city council and the Italian Chamber of Deputies
why_needs_multiple: Khoảng cách chỉ có nghĩa khi có hai lần bầu cử được nêu tên, nên câu cần đúng hai mốc.

question: Among the dated events recorded in the timeline, which were the earliest and the latest changes in his posts as editor-in-chief of the Democratic Party of the Left newspaper or as a government minister?
criterion: dated events of taking up or leaving the editor-in-chief post of the Democratic Party of the Left newspaper or a ministerial post
why_needs_multiple: Đáp án là đầu và cuối của chuỗi thay đổi chức vụ báo và chức bộ trưởng, nên cần ít nhất hai mốc.
